Method of Attack: Attacker requires Administrative access to exploit vulnerabilities in AMD Secure Processor (PSP) firmware and chipset
MasterKey: attacker updates flash to corrupt AMD Secure Processor (PSP) firmware contents undetected
RyzenFall and Fallout: attacker writes to AMD Secure Processor registers to exploit interface vulnerabilities between x86 and PSP
Chimera: attacker installs malicious driver exposing Promontory chipset functions to access physical memory and install malware
Impacted Systems: AMD Promontory chipset on socket AM4 desktop and socket TR4 high-end desktop (HEDT) platforms
Attack Vector: Requires Administrative access on compromised system
Method of Attack: Firmware patch release through BIOS update planned
Mitigations in progress with third-party chipset provider
